expected.finding: **[P2]** **Field failures cannot independently trigger topic mining.** In [revise-improvement-policy.py:659](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:659), the trigger starts with a number (`"5 field failures..."`), but the mining conditions check `startswith("field")`. With healthy archive coverage, five eligible field failures produce `action: none` even though direct mining produces a supported topic. Use an explicit boolean for this trigger.

**[P2]** **Deduplication discards evidence from different commands.** In [mine-trace-failures.py:225](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:225), failures are deduplicated by `(tool, excerpt)`, while topic classification also depends on the command. Two different commands returning `Permission denied` retain only the first command. The reproduction lost the archive failure and reported zero archive evidence, which can incorrectly influence weight discounts or rollback decisions. Include the command in the deduplication key.

**[P2]** **Successful shell reads become false field failures.** In [mine-trace-failures.py:179](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:179), failure-shaped text from any command tool counts regardless of successful status or command purpose. A successful `cat docs/example.md` containing `HTTP 401 Unauthorized token expired` produces credential and authentication evidence. Reading review documentation can therefore contaminate the supposedly independent anchor. Distinguish command execution failures from commands displaying file contents.
